reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The deprecated flag `install-egress-gateway-routes` has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Cilium deployments that specify the --install-egress-gateway-routes flag will have this setting ignored, as the flag has been removed.

proposed.statement: The deprecated CLI flag --install-egress-gateway-routes has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.
